text: さっき　おとしもの　したんだ　きみも　さがして　みて　くれる？

structure.jp: さっき　おとしもの　したんだ
structure.en: I dropped something a while ago, you see

structure.jp: さがして　みて　くれる？
structure.en: will you try looking for me?

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with みる means trying it to see how it goes. さがして　みて = 'try looking'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with くれる means someone does it as a favour to the speaker; as a question it is a casual request. さがして　みて　くれる？ = 'will you try looking for me?'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ and makes the sentence an explanation of the situation. おとしもの　したんだ = 'the thing is, I dropped something'.
